hypotheses.T0_exact_role_composition: All-role adjoints match direct gradients at every source layer and local role recomposition error is at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.T1_nontransport_roles_are_zero: MLP-only and query-only sensitivity at an earlier position is structurally zero at every source layer.
hypotheses.T2_key_value_is_material: Key-plus-value reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.70 at every layer and distance.
hypotheses.T3_no_transport_role_is_sufficient: Neither key-only nor value-only reaches 0.90 median cosine at every layer and distance.
hypotheses.T4_near_eight_blocks_are_sufficient: Full attention in the next eight blocks reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90 at every layer and distance.
hypotheses.T5_top64_finite_direction: Exact-gradient top-64 patches move the edit-defined score positively on at least 90 percent of sites at every layer and distance.
